name: Cut Shadow
description: The subject rests on a low plinth inside a deep, single-hue saturated color cove, where a hard gobo-cut spotlight throws sharp, hard-edged graphic shadow bars and cut shapes across the floor and back wall behind it. A gallery-installation mood with zero fill light — the shadow pattern reads as boldly as the product itself.
lighting: Single hard gobo-cut spotlight, no fill light
subject: product
